Location

Location helps show nearby people and events. Select it here, then allow access when your browser asks. Your device’s location services must also be enabled.

notifications
Notifications

Select notifications to receive alerts on this device. Both the browser and your system must allow them. Installing the app does not grant notification permission.

install_mobile
Install the app

Android: use Install app here or in your browser menu. iPhone / iPad: in Safari, choose Share → Add to Home Screen. Open that icon to enable notifications (iOS / iPadOS 16.4 or later).

block
Previously blocked?

MyScoutee cannot override a browser or system block. Change the permission in settings, return here and retry. Menu names vary by device and version.

android
Android settings

Chrome → Settings → Site settings → Location / Notifications: allow this site. Also check Android Settings → Apps → your browser or installed app → Permissions / Notifications. Then return to MyScoutee.

phone_iphone
iPhone / iPad settings

Location: Settings → Privacy & Security → Location Services; also check Location in Safari’s settings for this website. Alerts: Settings → Notifications → MyScoutee → Allow Notifications. Open MyScoutee from the Home Screen and retry.
